run_locust_benchmark: run a locust load test against a model endpoint using a custom input file
create_locust_http_user: create a Locust HttpUser subclass that reads input data and POSTs it to a model URL
test_model_endpoint: test a model serving endpoint by sending POST requests with custom content type headers
refactor_locust_task: refactor the Locust task method to support additional request validation or error handling
review_locust_parser: review the Locust command line parser listener that adds input, content-type, and model-url arguments
